literal_meaning: কালের ঘুম (মৃত্যুর ঘুম বা কালো ঘুম)
figurative_meaning_bn: চিরঘুম; মৃত্যু; এমন ঘুম যা ভাঙতে চায় না
figurative_meaning_en: eternal sleep; death; a sleep that cannot be broken
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কালঘুম হয়েছে, আর জাগবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He has fallen into eternal sleep and will not wake up.
Many fell into the sleep of death during the war.
note: Idiom evokes the finality of death through the metaphor of unending sleep, common in poetic Bengali expressions.
